adapter-entry-point.method: Accepted Workspace CLI Capability validation and clean staged Provider Entry Point generation

complete-provenance-context.method: Repository behavioral tests exercise the production read adapter and prove Notes/Tana authority provenance, full Toulmin fields, source-content SHA-256, exact source identity, a complete lifecycle-inclusive main-claim catalog, and distinct source-evidence, main-claim, and developing/monitoring thesis collections

claim-distinction-and-reuse.method: Repository behavioral tests force exact provenance reuse across claim lifecycle states, refuse a duplicate synthesis, and require synthesized investment recommendations to retain source provenance, qualifier, and every counterargument

bounded-conservative-result.method: Repository contract tests enforce the exact context digest, collection bounds, five-mapping per-claim limit, explicit ambiguity with no mapping, conservative semantic references, and execution={mode:recommendation_only,writes:[]}

authority-boundary.method: The production repository adapter exposes reads only; CLI and exact-adapter tests refuse ad-hoc SQL, Supabase MCP and direct API writes, claim create/link/promote, status, Decision Item, signal, strategy, position, trade, and broader execution authority

provider-semantic-equivalence.method: Compared the exact Claude adapter with issue #62, parent #46, predecessor #47, CONTEXT.md, current Notes/Trade Journal provenance authority, loose-agent documentation, and the useful non-writing intent of the legacy synthesize-claims workflow; the shared representative output fixture is bound to exact adapter bytes and no live provider invocation is claimed

eligible-environment.method: The configured repository runtime completed a live read-only preparation for one Notes-owned insight on 2026-08-08 (4 source claims, complete 2,146-claim identity catalog, 73 eligible theses, zero writes); behavioral and CLI proofs cover malformed source, database and environment unavailability, and stale prepared-context refusal without inferred state
